lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into a semi-regular grid of vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a series of anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a high-to-low vertical luminance gradient, indicating physical ridges.
